title: Foundation Seeding
purpose: Defines the workspace-seeding operations that generate candidate document skeletons from fixed templates and activate an empty product-specification workspace, together with the direction-evidence-installation operations that preserve direction material as byte-identical source evidence.

normative_requirements.text: Workspace seeding shall use the explicit product identifier and supplied product-direction material (as defined by the initialization request contract) to produce preserved direction evidence files, generated skeleton documents, and an activated but empty product-specification workspace in the repository/ directory inside the staging transaction root.

Every document produced by workspace seeding shall have lifecycle_status candidate; the component shall not invent product semantics, infer unspecified direction, supply acceptance claims, or synthesize normative requirement content.

Foundation seeding shall read each direction_material entry declared in the initialization request as byte-exact content from the local source repository at the exact source revision; the file shall be read as raw bytes without encoding conversion, line ending normalization, or other transformation, and the full byte content of each entry shall be preserved as-is regardless of content.

Each direction_material entry shall be assigned a positional index equal to its 0-based position in the direction_material array as received from request intake; the array order shall be preserved as the authoritative ordering key for all projection and naming decisions, and duplicate entries shall each receive their own distinct positional index.

Direction-material projection shall place each ingested entry as a file in the staging workspace under the deterministic path product/docs/direction/evidence/{index:03d}-{basename}, where index is the 0-based position in the direction_material array and basename is the exact filename portion of the entry's source path; the file content shall be the verbatim ingested bytes without any front matter, encoding conversion, line ending normalization, or other content modification.

Each projected direction-material file in product/docs/direction/evidence/ shall be a byte-identical copy of its source Git blob; the file shall receive no YAML front matter, no newline normalization, and no encoding transformation. Metadata about each entry shall be recorded separately in product/docs/direction/manifest.json.

When two or more direction_material entries resolve to the same basename, the projected filenames shall remain unique because each uses a distinct index prefix; no deduplication, renaming beyond the index prefix, or content merging shall occur.

Foundation seeding shall produce a direction evidence manifest at product/docs/direction/manifest.json containing for each entry the positional index, original source path, source revision (as a canonical Git object identity), source blob object ID (as a canonical Git object identity), projected evidence path, byte length, and optional non-authoritative detected media type; the manifest shall be stored separately from the evidence bytes.

Skeleton generation shall produce exactly one overview controlling document at product/docs/overview/{product_id}-OVERVIEW.md, one decomposition controlling document at product/docs/decompositions/{product_id}-DECOMPOSITION.md, and one implementation plan controlling document at product/docs/plans/{product_id}-IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md, where {product_id} is the product identifier from the initialization request.

The overview controlling document skeleton shall contain an H1 heading with the product identifier and the suffix 'Overview', a ## Purpose section with the static text 'This overview establishes the product direction, scope, and boundaries for {product_id}. It is a candidate directional document and is not normative.', a ## Scope section with the static text 'Overview scope is determined by the accepted decomposition and governing product specifications. This document records the directional boundary for the product.', a numbered placeholder sub-section for each of the six overview chunks (identity-and-purpose, problem-and-outcome, users-principles-boundaries, capabilities-and-success, unresolved-questions, lifecycle-and-handoff) each containing the static text 'Direction material for this section is available at the positional index identified by the chunk document. Content is not synthesized by the initializer.', an ## Open Questions section with the static text 'Unresolved questions are recorded in the unresolved-questions chunk document. No questions are synthesized by the initializer.', and a front-matter block with lifecycle_status: candidate, authority_category: directional, and overview_role: initial.

Skeleton generation shall produce exactly six overview chunk files under product/docs/overview/{product_id}-overview/ with the following filenames and H1 headings: chunk-01-identity-and-purpose.md ('Product Identity and Purpose'), chunk-02-problem-and-outcome.md ('Problem and Outcome'), chunk-03-users-principles-boundaries.md ('Users, Principles, and Boundaries'), chunk-04-capabilities-and-success.md ('Capabilities and Success'), chunk-05-unresolved-questions.md ('Unresolved Questions'), and chunk-06-lifecycle-and-handoff.md ('Lifecycle and Handoff'); each chunk file shall contain only its H1 heading, a single paragraph reading 'Direction material entries with positional indices relevant to this section are projected to product/docs/direction/. This chunk is a mechanically generated skeleton and does not contain synthesized product semantics.', and a front-matter block with lifecycle_status: candidate.

Skeleton generation shall produce exactly one decomposition controlling document at product/docs/decompositions/{product_id}-DECOMPOSITION.md containing an H1 heading with the product identifier and the suffix 'Decomposition', a ## Scope section with static text 'This decomposition identifies product areas and cross-cutting concerns for {product_id}. It is a candidate directional document and is not normative.', a ## Product Areas section listing four empty placeholder sub-sections (invocation-and-authority, product-areas, cross-cutting-concerns, stopping-criteria-and-handoff) each with the static text 'Decomposition area content is not synthesized by the initializer. Direction material for this area may be available in product/docs/direction/.', a ## Cross-cutting Concerns section with the static text 'Cross-cutting concerns are identified in the decomposition chunk documents. No concerns are synthesized by the initializer.', and a front-matter block with lifecycle_status: candidate and authority_category: directional.

Skeleton generation shall produce exactly four decomposition chunk files under product/docs/decompositions/{product_id}-decomposition/ with the following filenames and H1 headings: chunk-01-invocation-and-authority.md ('Invocation and Authority'), chunk-02-product-areas.md ('Product Areas'), chunk-03-cross-cutting-concerns.md ('Cross-cutting Concerns'), and chunk-04-stopping-criteria-and-handoff.md ('Stopping Criteria and Handoff'); each chunk file shall contain only its H1 heading, a single paragraph reading 'This decomposition chunk is a mechanically generated skeleton. Decomposition content is not synthesized by the initializer.', and a front-matter block with lifecycle_status: candidate.

Skeleton generation shall produce exactly one implementation plan controlling document at product/docs/plans/{product_id}-IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md containing an H1 heading with the product identifier and the suffix 'Implementation Plan', a ## Scope and Preconditions section with static text 'Implementation scope is defined by the governing product specifications and decomposition. This plan is a candidate planning document and is not normative.', a ## Workstreams and Dependencies section with static text 'Workstreams are identified in the implementation plan chunk documents. No workstream content is synthesized by the initializer.', a ## Validation and Completion section with static text 'Validation criteria are defined by the governing product specifications. No validation content is synthesized by the initializer.', a ## Risks and Unresolved Decisions section with static text 'Risks and unresolved decisions are recorded in the implementation plan chunk documents. No risk content is synthesized by the initializer.', and a front-matter block with lifecycle_status: candidate and authority_category: planning.

Skeleton generation shall produce exactly four implementation plan chunk files under product/docs/plans/{product_id}-implementation-plan/ with the following filenames and H1 headings: chunk-01-scope-and-preconditions.md ('Scope and Preconditions'), chunk-02-workstreams-and-dependencies.md ('Workstreams and Dependencies'), chunk-03-validation-and-completion.md ('Validation and Completion'), and chunk-04-risks-and-unresolved-decisions.md ('Risks and Unresolved Decisions'); each chunk file shall contain only its H1 heading, a single paragraph reading 'This implementation plan chunk is a mechanically generated skeleton. Plan content is not synthesized by the initializer.', and a front-matter block with lifecycle_status: candidate.

Skeleton generation shall produce discoverability README files at product/docs/overview/README.md, product/docs/decompositions/README.md, and product/docs/plans/README.md, each containing an H1 heading with the directory name and a link to the corresponding controlling document using the format 'See the [{title}]({relative_path}) controlling document.', plus a front-matter block with lifecycle_status: candidate.

A skeleton document that references direction material shall never embed, quote, paraphrase, summarize, or transform the content of any direction_material entry; all direction material content exists solely in product/docs/direction/ and is referenced only through the front-matter source metadata and the static placeholder text in the controlling documents.

Empty workspace initialization shall create the Level workspace README.md placeholder files at product/specs/product/level-0/README.md, product/specs/product/level-1/README.md, product/specs/product/level-2/README.md, and product/specs/product/level-3/README.md in the staging workspace to preserve the Level directories in Git. Each Level README shall state its Level identity, that the workspace is activated, that no product specifications currently exist at that Level, that generated content remains candidate and non-normative, and the governed next action for adding specifications to that Level. No specification JSON files shall be created inside these directories, and the component shall not produce candidate specification documents with normative requirement content.

Empty workspace initialization shall create a generated product manifest at product/specs/product/manifest.json containing spec_id 'product.manifest', status 'candidate', schema_version '1', an empty product_specifications array, and a title and purpose drawn from the product identifier; the manifest shall declare a dependency on repo.manifest and repo.product-manifest.

Empty workspace initialization shall produce a discoverability README at product/specs/product/README.md containing an H1 heading with the product identifier and the text 'This directory contains the activated but empty product-specification workspace for {product_id}.' followed by links to the overview, decomposition, and implementation plan controlling documents; the README shall have lifecycle_status candidate.

Foundation seeding shall produce only paths declared in the output inventory (product.initializer-output-inventory-v1) with producer direction-evidence-installation or workspace-seeding; every produced path shall match its inventory entry's operation, type, and mode, and no inventory entry with required true shall be omitted.
